name: @peartube/desktop-native
description: Native macOS shell scaffold for PearTube

scripts.build: xcodebuild -project PearTubeDesktop.xcodeproj -scheme PearTubeDesktop -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test: xcodebuild -project PearTubeDesktop.xcodeproj -scheme PearTubeDesktop -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test
